decisions.reason: Accepting the proposed stainless-steel whisk necessarily replaces the BOM's prior generic whisk selection.

source_message.text: That whisk will work. For the motor speed, let’s also set the maximum at 1500. What are your thoughts?

decisions.reason: The whisk selection does not change the existing splash target or conditional splash-guard policy.

The source decision concerns the whisk and motor speed, not spout geometry, orientation, material, or appearance.
Selecting a whisk and setting maximum motor speed does not change the dispensing mechanism, sequence, or flow requirements.
The source decision does not change the requirement that bowls be quickly removable and swappable.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY setting maximum_motor_speed_rpm to 1500, so no additional or edited Event is required.
The accepted whisk does not necessarily alter the enclosure thickness, well depth, or overall size constraint.
The source decision does not change the DJ-turntable visual theme.
The source decision has no effect on placard text, placement, or viewing orientation.
The whisk and motor-speed decision does not change the cleanability or removability requirements for the dispensing path.
The source decision does not alter the required leak-free seal behavior of the plumbing.
